title: Product comparison transports distributivity
statement: Let C and D be categories with binary products, and F : C → D a functor preserving binary products. Let R,X in C, R′,X′ in D, p : R′ ≅ F(R), q : X′ ≅ F(X), addV : X × X → X, addU : X′ × X′ → X′, and muV : R × X → X. Assume F(addV) = prodComparison(F,X,X) followed by (q⁻¹ × q⁻¹), addU, and q. Assume the source distributivity diagram: (id_R × addV) followed by muV equals the pair of muV after the first/second and first/third projections, followed by addV. Define mu = (p × q) followed by the inverse comparison for (R,X), F(muV), and q⁻¹. Then (id_R′ × addU) followed by mu equals the pair of mu after the first/second and first/third projections, followed by addU. No algebraic structures, adjunctions, sites or sectionwise descriptions are required.
